lastCompletedStory.title: Strip the named-command label so the gate executes the bare command

nextStoryContext: classifyOracleText in src/supervisor/behavioral-gate.ts now has an explicit named-command label branch placed right before the final fallthrough: `raw.startsWith('named-command ')` strips the label and trims the remainder into .command (empty remainder -> no-oracle, mirroring the file-assert/tmux-pty prefix branches), and a separate `raw === 'named-command'` exact-match branch (mirroring reviewer-judgment's exact-match style) yields no-oracle for the bare label alone since there is no trailing space to anchor a startsWith check once extractLastOracleRaw's .trim() has already removed it. This is deliberately NOT symmetric with the pre-existing file-assert/tmux-pty bare-label behavior (those still fall through to a named-command whose .command equals the label text itself, per the already-green tests at behavioral-gate.test.ts:167-187) -- that asymmetry was intentional per this story's AC2, not a leftover inconsistency to fix; do not 'fix' file-assert/tmux-pty to match without a story asking for it. A lookalike command that merely starts with the label text but isn't the label itself (e.g. 'named-commander --flag') is untouched because the space-anchored startsWith and the exact-match branch both miss it, falling through to the ordinary named-command case as before. runBehavioralGate itself was NOT touched -- it already just reads directive.command verbatim, so fixing the parser was sufficient to fix the send-keys argv end-to-end (AC3 confirmed this transitively). US-003 (malformed vs no-oracle for an unterminated mark) is unrelated to this branch and was left alone. No PRD/prd.json changes required by this story.
